74: // setNilHardforkTimestampsToDefault overwrites each unspecified hardfork activation time override
75: // with the superchain default.
76: func (c *ChainConfig) setNilHardforkTimestampsToDefault(s *SuperchainConfig) {
77: 	// Both the chain overrides and the superchain defaults are the same
78: 	// HardForkConfiguration struct, so we can iterate over their fields in
79: 	// lockstep and fill in any unspecified (nil) override from the default.
80: 	overrides := reflect.ValueOf(&c.HardForkConfiguration).Elem()
81: 	defaults := reflect.ValueOf(&s.hardForkDefaults).Elem()
82: 
83: 	for i := 0; i < overrides.NumField(); i++ {
84: 		override := overrides.Field(i)
85: 		if override.IsNil() {
86: 			override.Set(defaults.Field(i))
87: 		}
88: 	}
89:

95: 	//
96: 	// ...etc for each field in HardForkConfiguration
97: }
